indicators.name: Recovered-heat share of connected buildings' heat
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Seasonal load factor of the heat-recovery interface
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Backup dependency of served demand
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Levelised cost of network heat (system)
indicators.formula: (CAPEX x CRF + O&M + electricity incl. source side) / Q_network
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Annual net economic value (system, vs today)
indicators.formula: baseline cost of served demand - (annualised CAPEX + O&M + electricity + backup fuel)
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: External funding needed by the network operator
indicators.formula: max(0, -(tariff + connection - fence payments - operator capex x CRF - network O&M))
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Net CO2 avoided (LL97 factors)
indicators.formula: baseline CO2 of served demand - (electricity x 0.289 + backup fuel x EF)
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Energy Reuse Factor
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: On-site gas combustion displaced
indicators.formula: sum over gas buildings of (baseline fuel of served demand - backup fuel)
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Low-income households benefited
indicators.formula: NYCHA / DAC apartments connected (rebuild: replacement + new affordable share)
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: NYCHA heating-cost change per apartment
indicators.formula: NYCHA users' net value / NYCHA apartments (0 when none connected)
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Share of network heat delivered to low-income / DAC buildings
indicators.formula: 100 x Q_network(NYCHA or DAC buildings) / Q_network
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

indicators.name: Community facilities served
indicators.formula: number of connected schools, universities, museums, care facilities
indicators.normalisation: min-max over technically feasible configurations of the horizon (incl. today = no network); inverted for 'min'

tariff_rule: Term 4 affordability cap: NYCHA pays at most its break-even loop-heat rate, no connection charge (comparison under the pilot tariff in c_recommendations_pilot_tariff.csv)
decision_rule: AUTOMATIC: hard constraints HC0-HC7 (c_configurations.csv columns hard_pass, HC0..HC7) then least public support per tCO2 avoided (support_per_tCO2); see c_recommendations.json -> recommendation
overall_score: OPTIONAL visualisation/sensitivity only: sum_d w_d x score_d from score_T/E/N/S columns with user weights (sum 100%); min-max scores are size-biased and do not drive the recommendation
default_weights: equal 25% each: a demonstration baseline for the optional score only
governance_note: 37 unscored governance/delivery items are shown next to the recommendation; no numeric score is given to them.
